name: Skop Publish
author: Fahed Toumi

sections.description:
Skop Publish connects your WordPress site to Skop so you can display the products you already manage in your inventory.

You add and update your reclaimed materials in Skop. The plugin then makes them available on your WordPress site as a catalog, product pages, and Gutenberg blocks you can insert into your content.

This keeps Skop as the single place where your product data is managed while giving you a WordPress site that matches your brand and communication needs.

What you can do with Skop Publish

  • display your Skop products on your WordPress site
  • connect one Skop shop to your WordPress site
  • create a catalog page and product pages
  • insert product lists into pages with Gutenberg blocks
  • update your site without recreating product data manually
  • optionally allow visitors to send a product inquiry from a product page

External Services

This plugin connects to the Skop service after the site administrator confirms the connection from Skop.

Skop is used to:
* confirm which Skop shop is connected to the WordPress site
* read the products that should be displayed on the site
* update the catalog displayed in WordPress
* send a product inquiry when that option is enabled on a product page

Data sent to Skop:
* during the guided connection: the site URL, the WordPress callback URL, and the selected shop identifier
* during catalog updates: the site URL, the plugin version, and the selected catalog identifier
* during a product inquiry submission: the visitor name, email address, request reason, typed message, site URL, and the URL of the related product page

These requests only happen when an administrator configures the plugin, runs a catalog update, or when a visitor explicitly sends a product inquiry from a product page.

Useful links:
* Skop website: https://www.skop.app/
* Skop marketplace: https://www.skop.app/marketplace-materiaux-reemploi
* Terms and conditions: https://www.skop.app/conditions-generales-de-vente-et-dutilisation
* Privacy policy: https://www.skop.app/politique-confidentialite
* Support: support@skop.app

Source Files and Build Tools

The distributed plugin package includes the original block source files used to generate the bundled Gutenberg block assets.

You can review them directly in:
* src/blocks/featured-resources/
* src/blocks/resource-grid/

The JavaScript shipped in build/blocks/ is generated from those files during release. The frontend assets in assets/ are also included in readable form in the plugin package.

Who is it for?

Skop Publish is for organizations that already manage reclaimed materials or reusable products in Skop and want to present them on their own WordPress website.

What the plugin is not

Skop Publish is not a second product back office.
It is a display and publishing plugin for data that continues to be managed in Skop.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate Skop Publish from the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Skop Publish settings page.
  4. Click Connect with Skop.
  5. Sign in to Skop if needed and confirm the connection for the current shop.
  6. Return automatically to WordPress.
  7. Customize the catalog title, introductory text, and public URL slug.
  8. Run the first catalog update.
  9. Check the public catalog on your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Skop account?

Yes. The plugin needs access to Skop in order to retrieve the products that will be displayed on your site.

How does the connection work?

You start from WordPress with Connect with Skop, sign in to Skop if needed, then confirm the current shop in Skop. The secure connection is stored automatically in WordPress.

Do I need to recreate product pages in WordPress?

No. You manage the products in Skop and the plugin displays them on your WordPress site.

Does the plugin work without Gutenberg blocks?

Yes. The plugin also creates a catalog archive and individual product pages.

How do I update the catalog?

You can run a catalog update from the WordPress admin. A WP-CLI command can also be used in production.

Can I customize the catalog page?

Yes. You can choose the catalog slug, its public title, its introductory text, and some of the information shown on product cards.

How many Skop shops can one WordPress site publish?

For the current MVP, one WordPress site publishes one Skop shop at a time.

Do I need an API URL, a token, or a shop ID in WordPress?

No. The public plugin uses a guided connection flow. You start from WordPress, confirm the current shop in Skop, and the secure connection is stored automatically.
